packageRules.description: Dart and Flutter packages weekly, as Dependabot's pub ecosystem did (the shared preset does not enable the pub manager, so it is listed in enabledManagers above, with the preset's own).

drift_dev's generated code calls the drift runtime, so the two must match: drift_dev 2.35.3's output needs drift 2.35.4, and Renovate's #83 (drift_dev alone) did not compile. drift, drift_dev and drift_flutter update together, in one pull request.
GitHub Actions weekly and in one pull request, as Dependabot's github-actions group did.
